# Delta on PR #7175 (your PR, branch agy/ci-timings-7174) — one blocking finding

Read the driver pre-review comment on PR #7175 (`gh pr view 7175 --comments`): `--limit` is applied during fetch before the event/branch filters, so `--event push --limit 5` reports 0 runs. Fix it as described there (API-side `event=`/`branch=` query params so `--limit` means "most recent N *matching* runs"; keep the post-fetch filter; add the fixture test where `--limit` is smaller than the number of newer non-matching runs; clarify `--help`).

Acceptance (quote raw output in your final report):
1. `.venv/bin/python scripts/ci/ci_timings.py --event push --since 2d --limit 5` shows `## push (5 completed runs)` (or fewer only if fewer exist).
2. `.venv/bin/python scripts/ci/ci_timings.py --event merge_group --since 2d --limit 5` shows 5 merge_group runs.
3. `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_ci_timings.py tests/test_subprocess_timeout_guard.py` passes, including the new limit test; mutation-check: revert the fix → the new test fails (quote it), then restore.
4. `.venv/bin/ruff check scripts/ci/ci_timings.py tests/test_ci_timings.py` clean.

Commit on the same branch (conventional message, X-Agent trailer), push. Do NOT merge or arm auto-merge. Report the new head SHA.

### Summary of Changes

1. **API-Side Query Filtering (`scripts/ci/ci_timings.py`)**:
   - Added `event` and `status` query parameters to [`fetch_workflow_runs_from_api()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/scripts/ci/ci_timings.py#L351-L373) (omitting `event` when `"all"`, passing `event={event}` when specified, and defaulting to `status="completed"`).
   - Updated [`main()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/scripts/ci/ci_timings.py#L841-L855) to pass `event=args.event` into `fetch_workflow_runs_from_api()`, ensuring API-side pagination and `--limit` operate on the pre-filtered set of matching runs.
   - Retained post-fetch filtering in [`analyze_timings()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/scripts/ci/ci_timings.py#L432-L466) as defense in depth.
   - Updated `--limit` `--help` text in [`build_arg_parser()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/scripts/ci/ci_timings.py#L787-L791) to clarify that `--limit` specifies the maximum number of most recent *matching* runs to evaluate.

2. **Test Coverage (`tests/test_ci_timings.py`)**:
   - Added [`test_analyze_timings_limit_with_newer_non_matching_runs()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/tests/test_ci_timings.py#L345-L362): verifies that `--limit` on fixture data returns the N most recent matching runs when newer non-matching runs exist.
   - Added [`test_fetch_workflow_runs_passes_query_params()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/tests/test_ci_timings.py#L365-L397): verifies query parameters (`event=push`, `branch=main`, `status=completed`, `per_page=100`, and omission of `event=` when `all`).
   - Added [`test_fetch_workflow_runs_api_event_limit_with_newer_non_matching_runs()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/tests/test_ci_timings.py#L400-L430) and [`test_cli_main_api_event_limit_matching_runs()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ci-timings-7174/tests/test_ci_timings.py#L433-L463): simulates API response behaviors and verifies that `main(["--event", "push", "--limit", "2"])` produces `## push (2 completed runs)` rather than `0 completed runs`.
